The Shadowdancer is a lithe, agile and deadly female operative in flowing shadowsilk cloak and tactical gear, dual glowing energy daggers held low in ready stance, faint emerald shadow tendrils swirling as she absorbs the command with lethal focus.

Subtle emerald s-expressions and Clojure-style symbols glow like arcane inscriptions on the massive dungeon architecture. Dramatic heroic lighting, rich saturated colors with deep crimson and emerald accents, stylized yet detailed character models, epic composition, solemn and powerful mood, in the classic art style of World of Warcraft Burning Crusade / Wrath of the Lich King.
